nodes.summary: The number of original copies amplified by the event (`desc i ≥ 2`).
nodes.title: Number of amplified copies

nodes.summary: Copy-neutral loss of heterozygosity `1 + 1 → 2 + 0`: one copy duplicated, the other lost.
nodes.title: Copy-neutral loss of heterozygosity

nodes.summary: If some copy is amplified, two parameter pairs `(μ, t)`, `(μ', t')` with `μ, μ' ≠ 0` and the same expected multiplicity spectrum are equal.
nodes.title: Identifiability

nodes.summary: Expected number of mutations of multiplicity `m`: `μ t #{i | desc i = m} + [m = 1] μ c₁ (1 - t)` (per-copy rate `μ`, event at time `t` of the normalized history `[0, 1]`).
nodes.title: Expected number of mutations of a given multiplicity

nodes.summary: An event that amplifies some copy leaves a positive copy number.
nodes.title: Positive copy number after an amplifying event

nodes.summary: The copy number `c₁ = ∑ i, desc i` after the event.
nodes.title: Copy number after a copy-number event

nodes.summary: A single copy-number event on a region: `copies` original copies, of which copy `i` has `desc i` copies after the event (`0` if lost, `2` if duplicated).
nodes.title: Copy-number gain history
The mutation rate from the spectrum

nodes.summary: A single-copy gain `1 + 1 → 2 + 1`: one copy duplicated, the other kept.
nodes.title: Single-copy gain

nodes.summary: The mutations of multiplicity at least two number `μ t #{i | desc i ≥ 2}` in expectation: they all arose before the event, on an amplified copy.
nodes.title: Expected count of mutations on amplified copies

nodes.summary: `∑_m m E_m = μ c₁`, summing over all multiplicities up to a bound `B ≥ max(1, max_i desc i)`.
nodes.title: The multiplicity-weighted total is time-invariant

nodes.summary: When some copy is amplified and `μ ≠ 0`, `t = c₁ ∑_{m ≥ 2} E_m / (#{i | desc i ≥ 2} ∑_m m E_m)`.
nodes.title: The timing closed form

nodes.summary: Whole-genome doubling of a diploid region `1 + 1 → 2 + 2`.
nodes.title: Whole-genome doubling event

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
